notes: Better spell builds: the search now also starts from an ability tree built around each archetype (when you don't pick one yourself), because the strongest spell builds often commit fully to one archetype and a single search tends to stop at a mix. In our tests: Shaman level 60 spells +22%, Mage level 40 spells +13%. It can't make a build worse (the normal search still runs and the best wins), but builds where spells count take about twice as long.
